spec.name: RIDGE_HGB_RESIDUAL_120

temporal_model.input: 12 calendar months ending M-1, log1p(RCYL/s), SCTS/calendar_days and separate finite masks; each interacts with normalized horizon powers0..3, plus horizon powers1..3

feature_model.training_target: log1p(RCYL/s) minus same-outer-training-fitted Ridge prediction on those training rows

spec.residual_scope: ordinary additive residual training; no validation prediction or label enters either fit; not nested/cross-fitted stacking
spec.scale: raw last legal RCYL if finite and >0 else1
spec.weights: no sample weights; no tuned blend or routing
spec.not_a_claim: branch names describe intended roles, not a causal decomposition or proven importance

hypothesis: a regularized temporal trajectory plus shallow nonlinear feature correction may generalize with smaller artifacts than ExtraTrees; this is a single architecture trial, not a causal isolation of learner vs new time inputs
evaluation: fresh paired B0 fixed5 then five repeated grouped5 seeds1..5; same81 wells, not independent confirmation
preprocessors: one top-level pipeline per model fit, independently counted; 92 on successful run

baseline_gate.all_six_R17_scores: also matched before same-split candidate; mismatch stops

threshold_provenance: B engineering criteria locked before scores; not user-quoted thresholds or significance evidence
full_model_policy: save exactly two branch artifacts after structurally valid CV, even if negative, as private research output requested by user; status explicitly research-only when screening fails
temporal_only_scores: descriptive ablation from same fitted Ridge, not an additional selectable candidate; no score-based path/weight/parameter changes
parallelism: folds and branches sequential; OMP/BLAS1; B0 ExtraTrees n_jobs=-1; Ridge svd; HGB one OpenMP thread
unchanged: raw inputs and selected81 well queue
